newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Jan-Aug coal imports soar 139.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China's Jan-Aug coal imports soar 139.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's imports of coal soared 139.1 percent in the first eight months of 1996 to 2.0 million tonnes compared with 830,000 tonnes in the year-ago period, customs figures showed on Monday.
Imports in August were 280,000 tonnes, the figures showed.
China's coal exports were 17.03 million tonnes in the first eight months, down by 5.2 percent from 17.97 million tonnes in the year-ago period, the figures showed.
Exports in August were 3.59 million tonnes, the figures showed.
